ECON 101: Principles of Microeconomics (synthetic example course)

Grading: Problem sets 30%, Midterm Exam 30%, Final Exam 40%.

Schedule
Week 1-3: Supply, demand and elasticity.
Week 4-6: Consumer choice and producer theory.
The Midterm Exam will be held in class on October 8, 2026.
Week 7-12: Market structures, externalities, public goods.
The Final Exam is cumulative; date to be announced by the registrar.
